newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Roche says U.S. FDA panel recommends Posicor drug.
newsitem.headline: Roche says U.S. FDA panel recommends Posicor drug.

text.p: Roche Holding AG said on Monday that a U.S. Food and Drug Administration medical advisory panel had recommended approving its Posicor drug (Mibefradil) for the treatment of high blood pressure and chronic stable angina.
"The panel recommendation represents a milestone for Roche," it said in a statement.

"After the FDA gives final approval for Posicor, Roche's presence in the heart-circulatory sector will be significantly strengthened, even more so given Roche's pushing ahead with additional cardiovascluar medicines."
Posicor, a new calcium channel antagonist, has already been approved for use in the Netherlands and Switzerland, it said.
Clinical studies show the drug is at least as good if not better than other calcium antagonists, it said. More clinical tests are under way, with final results expected in mid-1998.
